note: Built from the official trophy descriptions and the published roadmaps (KeenGamer, PowerPyx, GamesFuze). Around 200 hours in total, difficulty 4/10, a single playthrough, and no online trophies.

stages.text: Play all five chapters as Jason and Lucia. The four chapter trophies and the seven mission trophies pop along the way, and so do the vague story trophies. Do the balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — it is the only thing in the whole game that can be missed.
stages.title: Finish the story

stages.text: Clear the eight Strangers & Freaks strands, the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, and Bret's unique-animal hunt. There are more strands than the eight the Silver needs, so take the ones you like best.
stages.title: Side characters & strangers

stages.text: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win drone races at all 14 Top Fun spots, win 20 different races, beat Cal at fishing, finish one arcade game, try all nine activity types, land 250 stunts, finish 50 challenges and meditate at every spot.
stages.title: Activities & skills

stages.text: Rob five bank vaults, stop an armored truck, rob a jewelry store unseen, rob three shops in a row, hit one Illegal Operation for each of the nine gangs, and shake a 4-star wanted level — with your partner beside you wherever the trophy asks for it.
stages.title: Crime with your partner

stages.text: Close out the long counts — 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 vehicles found, all eight garages, $100,000 spent and $250,000 laundered — then clear the 100% Completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) for A Long Road. The Platinum pops with it.
stages.title: Collectibles, 100% & the platinum

title: Roadmap to the platinum
